description: Blocks Agent/Task (and equivalent task-tool) subagent dispatch while the machine is under memory pressure — jetsam level >= agent_hooks.memory_gate.block_at_pressure_level (default 2), free RAM below min_free_mb (default 512), or swap use above max_swap_used_pct (default 85). Complements heavy-op-memory-gate (pre-bash heavy commands). Thresholds live in rig.yaml under agent_hooks.memory_gate or env RIG_MEMORY_* overrides. Stateless, no hatch bypass; fail-open when no reliable signal. Added for agent-tools#519.
